title: Spears Of Deceit
subtitle: The Story of battle of Siffin
author: Ghulamreza Aabruye
description: In the distant past, two bands of trained warriors faced each other across a desert plain. Exhausted both in body and spirit, each group impatiently awaits the command of its leader.

Two men – one stained with dark, one pure light – stand behind the thousands; two men who need the loyalty of their soldiers to save the future of Islam; two men in whose hands the fate of the Muslim ummah lies; two men who must make difficult choices.
But only one of them is lion-hearted; guided by absolute faith and an unswerving love for Allah (s) and His creation.
Who will the Muslims stand with? Will they make the right decision or will they be doomed to forever regret the outcome of that fateful day…?
